Audit PDF source-of-truth wireframes referenced in plan.

5 sprints just shipped. Read-only audit of every visual decision against Brand Board v1.0.

## Files to audit (visuals only)

- app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx (page chrome + KPI strip placement + InventoryHub)
- components/inventory/InventoryKPIStrip.tsx (NEW)
- components/inventory/InventoryKPIStripSkeleton.tsx (NEW)

- components/inventory/ItemForm.tsx (Min default + Use default link)
- components/inventory/StockAlertsPanel.tsx (3 states: has_alerts, all_clear, cant_fire)
- components/inventory/BulkThresholdsDrawer.tsx (NEW Sheet drawer)
- components/inventory/PurchaseOrdersTable.tsx (line count, status pills, dropdown, overdue pill)
- components/inventory/SuppliersTable.tsx (last_ordered, YTD, dropdown)
- components/inventory/MovementsLog.tsx (quick-range chips, Source column)
- app/globals.css (verify all new code uses existing tokens, no token additions)

## Audit checklist (Brand v1.0 — strict)

### Palette
- Only Bone (#F7F7F5) / Onyx (#0F0F0F) / Stone (#787774) / Rust (#B23A2B). Zero exceptions.
- Zero `#FFFFFF` (use Bone). Zero `#000000` (use Onyx).
- Zero raw hex literals in components — only semantic tokens from globals.css `@theme inline`.
- Zero gradients. Solid surfaces only.
- **One Rust accent per viewport rule** — count Rust elements visible at once on each page state:
  - Inventory page (default Items view): KPI BELOW MIN border (when count > 0) is one. Reorder buttons on individual rows are conditional — if 5 items below min show Rust Reorder buttons, that's contextual repetition (allowed), not decorative.
  - Stock Alerts page: bulk action bar Rust accent on "+ Add to PO". One Rust per viewport.
  - POs page: Overdue pill on a single row counts as one. If multiple POs overdue, flag for redesign or accept as repeated status indicator.
  - Suppliers page: should have ZERO Rust accents (no hot signal here).
  - Movements page: ZERO Rust accents (audit trail, not actionable).

### Typography
- Inter on body / labels / numbers.
- Instrument Serif ONLY on display moments (page titles, italic accent words, empty-state titles).
- JetBrains Mono on SKUs / batch numbers / API responses.
- KPI strip numbers: Inter 800 32–52px. NOT Instrument Serif (numbers stay Inter per CLAUDE.md 4.4 rule 4).
- Empty-state titles: Instrument Serif italic ("Inventory within healthy range" · "No minimums set").
- Tabular-nums on every number (KPIs · prices · counts · percentages · stock pills).
- Uppercase Stone labels at 11px / `tracking-0.08em` (KPI labels · "ALL CLEAR" · "ALERTS CAN'T FIRE").

### Shadows
- Only `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-card-hover`, `shadow-soft-md`, `shadow-lift`, `shadow-overlay`.
- Forbidden: `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`, `shadow-2xl`.

### Stock pill states (S2 spec)
- `current_stock <= min_threshold` → Rust filled (`bg-rust text-bone`)
- `current_stock <= min_threshold * 1.25` → Rust outlined
- else → Stone outlined
- All counts tabular-nums.

### Filter chip pattern (S2)
- Stone outlined chip with icon + label + Select. Confirm visual rhythm consistent with existing app patterns.

### KPI strip (S5)
- Bone surface, hairline Stone border, `shadow-soft`.
- Stone uppercase 11px label `tracking-0.08em`.
- Onyx number Inter 800 32px mobile / 52px desktop.
- BELOW MIN: 2px Rust LEFT border ONLY when count > 0. When count = 0, normal card.

### Empty states (S3)
- ALL CLEAR: Stone circle with checkmark + Instrument Serif italic title + Stone body + outline CTA.
- ALERTS CAN'T FIRE: Rust uppercase label + Rust-tint circle with `!` icon + Instrument Serif italic title + Stone body + Onyx primary + outline CTAs.

### Overdue pill (S4)
- Small Rust pill `Overdue · {N}d`, NEVER full-row Rust fill.
- Tabular-nums on the day count.

### DropdownMenu pattern (S4)
- 3-dot trigger icon, Stone border, Onyx items on hover.
- Cancel item is Rust text only — never Rust background.

### Quick-range chips (S4)
- Stone outlined default, Onyx fill on active.
- Group above From/To picker.

### Motion
- Stillness is the brand. No spinners on hover, no carousel autoscroll, no decorative motion.
- Skeleton loaders OK. Toast slide-in OK. Drawer open OK. All 150ms ease-out.

### Empty values
- Use `—` (em dash) Stone color for null/empty data, never "N/A" / "None" / blank cells.

## Output format

For each file, list any deviation as:
- **CRITICAL** (blocks ship) — concrete spec break with line ref + fix.
- **WARNING** (ship with followup) — soft deviation worth noting.
- **NOTES** (informational).

Then a final **VERDICT**: APPROVE / APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOWUPS / REJECT.

Do NOT modify files — read-only audit. Reference exact file:line numbers.
